notes: Official Code of Alabama viewer opened via its GraphQL endpoint (section text + history); history line for §§ 36-12-40, -41 shows Act 2024-278 §1 and for §§ 36-12-43 to -46 shows only Act 2024-278 §2, with the viewer current through Act 2026-592 (§ 36-12-47 present) — no 2025/2026 amendment to the fee provisions. Row official_link is the viewer root (no stable per-section URL); every cited section was re-pulled independently from the viewer's GraphQL endpoint (codesOfAlabama query by displayId, versions:true — one version each, supersessionDate null) and every source_language segment was string-matched verbatim against the pulled text (36/36 pass; rules.maxFee's § 36-12-43(a) segment is verbatim with a trailing '...' truncation). Web search for 2025/2026 bills amending §§ 36-12-41/-44 found none; the viewer's section histories (current through Act 2026-592) are the authoritative currency check.
